overview.about: The Players Championship is the PGA Tour's flagship event, often called the 'fifth major' for its elite field - the strongest in golf - and its huge purse. It is played every March at TPC Sawgrass in Florida, home of the intimidating island-green 17th hole, one of the most famous holes in the game.
overview.nextEvent: The next Players Championship is played at TPC Sawgrass in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. The Stadium Course and its par-3 17th island green routinely decide the tournament and produce the season's most dramatic finishes.
